run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend-proxy since 2026-11-18T00:09:46Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The warning alert on otel-demo/frontend-proxy was accompanied by real frontend-proxy error spans: the 'ingress' server operation and the 'router frontend egress' client operation each gained error spans in two batches at the 00:01:15 and 00:02:15 scrapes (+29 then +40). The error chain visible in the span metrics is frontend-proxy -> frontend POST /api/checkout (and its grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder client span) -> checkout's client span oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge; checkout accumulated 69 errored Charge spans in the same two batches. At 00:00:08 the payment Deployment was rollout-restarted: the new ReplicaSet payment-54499f9786 carries pod-template annotation kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt=2026-11-18T00:00:08Z with an otherwise identical template (same image, env and 20m/160Mi resources), the old pod was killed at 00:00:11, and the replacement pod was Ready at 00:00:11 although its application only logged 'payment gRPC server started on port 8080' at 00:01:26.571Z and received its first Charge at 00:01:59.971Z. During that startup the container sat at its 20m CPU limit with 88-93% of CFS periods throttled. This supports a restart/startup-gap explanation for the Charge failures and the propagated frontend/frontend-proxy errors, but the object that triggered the rollout restart is not visible (change history is not integrated), so no root-cause object is named. The flagd-config ConfigMap currently holds paymentUnreachable='on' ('Payment service is unavailable'), but the running flagd serves a copy of that file taken by its init container when the flagd pod started at 23:29:50, and Charge calls succeeded continuously while the ConfigMap still reads 'on'; that setting remains an unconfirmed candidate. The alert's own start (00:09:46) is later than the large error batch and the rule expression could not be read, so the exact window producing the reported 0.0222 is unknown.

claims.text: frontend-proxy's own error-span counters moved with the incident: traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="frontend-proxy",span_name="router frontend egress",span_kind="SPAN_KIND_CLIENT",status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"} went 435 (00:01:00) -> 464 (00:01:15) -> 504 (00:02:15) and stayed 504 to 00:10, and the matching 'ingress' SPAN_KIND_SERVER error counter went 514 (00:01:00) -> 543 (00:01:15) -> 583 (00:02:15).

The same frontend-proxy counters show small background increments outside the burst: the ingress error counter rose by +1 at the 00:00:15 scrape, the egress error counter stayed flat at 435 before the burst, and after the burst the ingress counter rose again by +1 at 00:03:45, +1 at 00:07:15 and +2 at 00:09:45.

checkout's error spans were confined to two operations: sum(increase(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="checkout",status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[5m])) by span_name returned only span_name 'oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder' and 'oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge', with identical values (60.18 at 00:03, 51.25 at 00:04, 49.71 at 00:05, 45.56 at 00:06) and 0 in every other sampled bucket from 23:50 to 00:20.

The cumulative counter traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="checkout",span_name="oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge",status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"} first appears at 28 at the 00:01:15 scrape, is 69 at 00:02:15 and stays 69 through 00:06; the 5-minute error increase for that span is 0 from 00:07 onward, so the window contains 69 failed Charge spans in two batches.

frontend's error spans are on the checkout route only: 5-minute error increases of 31.11 / 76.67 / 74.15 / 76.67 / 45.56 at 00:02-00:06 for span_name 'POST', 'POST /api/checkout', 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout' and 'grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder', while 'GET', 'GET /api/cart', 'GET /api/data', 'grpc.oteldemo.CartService/GetCart', 'grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds' and 'tcp.connect' error increases are 0 in the same buckets.

Among the error-span series returned by sum(increase(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[5m])) by service_name, the burst-sized increases at 00:02-00:06 are on checkout, frontend and frontend-proxy; ad, fraud-detection and recommendation show recurring ~1.1 per 5m counts that are also present before the burst, while accounting and payment are 0 throughout.

The payment Deployment's new ReplicaSet payment-54499f9786 was created 2026-11-18T00:00:08Z with pod-template annotation kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt=2026-11-18T00:00:08Z and is deployment revision 2; its pod template is otherwise identical to revision 1 ReplicaSet payment-55766d76b9 (created 2026-11-17T23:27:56Z): same image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-payment, same env (PAYMENT_PORT 8080, FLAGD_HOST flagd, FLAGD_PORT 8013), same resources limits cpu 20m / memory 160Mi.

otel-demo events place the payment rollout precisely: ReplicaSet payment-54499f9786 SuccessfulCreate at 00:00:08 and Deployment payment ScalingReplicaSet 0->1 at 00:00:08; Pod payment-54499f9786-4r25d Scheduled 00:00:08, container Created 00:00:10, Started 00:00:11; Pod payment-55766d76b9-846r8 Killing at 00:00:11 and Deployment payment scaled down 1->0 at 00:00:11 with ReplicaSet payment-55766d76b9 SuccessfulDelete. No payment Pod Evicted, OOMKilled or failed event appears in the events returned.

The replacement payment pod payment-54499f9786-4r25d is Running, restartCount 0, container startedAt 2026-11-18T00:00:11Z, with condition Ready=True at lastTransitionTime 00:00:11Z - i.e. it was Ready and routable about 75 seconds before its application began listening.

The new payment container's log contains only two lines in the 00:00:00-00:02:00 window: 'payment gRPC server started on port 8080' at 2026-11-18T00:01:26.571Z and the first 'Charge request received.' at 2026-11-18T00:01:59.971Z.

The new payment container ran at its CPU ceiling during startup: sum(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace="otel-demo",pod="payment-54499f9786-4r25d",container="payment"}[1m])) is ~0.0200 cores (equal to its 20m limit) from 00:00:45 to 00:02:00, and its CFS throttled-period ratio is 0.88 at 00:01, 0.93 at 00:02 and 0.92 at 00:03 before falling to 0.63/0.34/0.29/0.24; the previous pod payment-55766d76b9-846r8 ran at 0.12-0.23 over 23:42-00:02.

payment's own telemetry records no failures: at 00:05 the payment span series were span_name 'charge' STATUS_CODE_UNSET 76.47 and 'grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge' STATUS_CODE_UNSET 76.47, and its container log between 00:01:59.971Z and 00:07:58.160Z shows repeated 'Charge request received.' / 'Transaction complete.' pairs.

The flagd-config ConfigMap in otel-demo holds a fault-injection setting named paymentUnreachable with state ENABLED, defaultVariant 'on', variants {off:false, on:true} and description 'Payment service is unavailable'; paymentFailure is defaultVariant 'off' (variants 0.1/1/0.25/0.5/0.75/0.95/0) and every other flag in the same document (adFailure, adHighCpu, adManualGc, cartFailure, emailMemoryLeak, imageSlowLoad, kafkaQueueProblems, loadGeneratorFloodHomepage, productCatalogFailure, recommendationCacheFailure) is defaultVariant 'off'.

The flagd Deployment runs /flagd-build start --port 8013 --ofrep-port 8016 --uri file:./etc/flagd/demo.flagd.json from an emptyDir (config-rw), and its init container init-config runs 'cp /config-ro/demo.flagd.json /config-rw/demo.flagd.json' from the flagd-config ConfigMap once at pod start; the flagd pod flagd-678dcfdc67-bl78w has a startTime of 2026-11-17T23:29:50Z and restartCount 0.

The flagd-config ConfigMap was created 2026-11-17T23:27:55Z with resourceVersion 1599998; the object exposes no modification timestamp, so when its paymentUnreachable value was last changed is not observable from this data.

frontend-proxy-6b4d584985-sznks, frontend-675fd7b5c5-zjtpt, checkout-5dccddf8bb-h9bvp and every one of the 21 otel-demo pods returned are Running and Ready with restartCount 0; the only otel-demo workload objects that appear as changed in the event summary are the payment ReplicaSet/Pod entries recorded above (2 Deployment ScalingReplicaSet, 1 Pod Created/Killing/Started, 1 ReplicaSet SuccessfulCreate and 1 SuccessfulDelete).

The payment Service endpoint currently resolves to a single address 100.96.5.201:8080 on Pod payment-54499f9786-4r25d, and the frontend-proxy Service endpoint to 100.96.5.22:8080 on Pod frontend-proxy-6b4d584985-sznks; none of the 19 Services in otel-demo currently has empty subsets.

By 00:20:00 the frontend-proxy error rate had returned to 0: sum(rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="frontend-proxy",status_code!=""}[5m])) by (span_name,status_code) returned STATUS_CODE_ERROR = 0 for both 'ingress' and 'router frontend egress' (UNSET 3.077 and 3.073 spans/s respectively).

frontend-proxy's 5-minute error rate was already nonzero before the incident: sum(rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="frontend-proxy",status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[5m])) by span_name shows 'ingress' values around 0.0037-0.0185 per second on the samples from 23:40 to 00:01 and 0 for 'router frontend egress' in that period, then burst values of 0.107-0.259 per second at 00:02-00:06.

The paymentUnreachable='on' value in the flagd-config ConfigMap is not shown to have been in effect during the failures: flagd serves the emptyDir copy of that file written by its init container when the flagd pod started at 23:29:50, and while the ConfigMap still reads 'on' every checkout Charge call from 00:02 onward succeeded (the checkout Charge error increase is 0 from 00:07, payment processed ~76-96 Charge spans per 5 minutes with STATUS_CODE_UNSET, and its log shows 'Transaction complete.').

payment itself did not report failures during the incident: the payment span series returned for 00:05 are STATUS_CODE_UNSET for 'charge', 'grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge', 'dns.lookup' and 'tcp.connect' with no STATUS_CODE_ERROR series, while the fleet-wide error query returned payment error increases of 0 in every sampled bucket from 23:00 to 00:20.

Primary hypothesis: the payment Deployment's rollout restart at 00:00:08 (recorded only as the pod-template annotation kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt with an otherwise unchanged template) left the single payment replica Ready at 00:00:11 but with no listening gRPC server until 00:01:26.571Z, while its container was pinned at the 20m CPU limit and throttled 88-93%; checkout's Charge calls during that gap failed (69 error spans, 28 then +41), and the failure propagated to frontend POST /api/checkout and to frontend-proxy's ingress and 'router frontend egress' error spans that the alert reflects.

Alternative candidate hypothesis: the value paymentUnreachable='on' ('Payment service is unavailable') held in ConfigMap otel-demo/flagd-config was in effect for part of 00:01-00:02 and made checkout treat payment as unreachable. This can be neither confirmed nor excluded from the available data, because the ConfigMap's modification time and the values flagd actually serves are not observable; it is contradicted by the fact that Charge calls succeeded continuously while the ConfigMap still reads 'on'.

Rejected: the Charge failures came from a payment pod crash, OOM kill or eviction. payment-54499f9786-4r25d is Running with restartCount 0 and no previous container instance exists, and the otel-demo events show only controller-driven SuccessfulCreate/SuccessfulDelete/ScalingReplicaSet entries for the payment Deployment - no Evicted, OOMKilling or Failed events.

Rejected: payment returned application-level errors to checkout (the paymentFailure percentage setting). paymentFailure is defaultVariant 'off' in flagd-config, payment's server spans carry only STATUS_CODE_UNSET, and payment logs successful 'Transaction complete.' pairs for the requests it received.

Rejected: another frontend downstream (cart, currency, product-catalog, shipping, ad) failed and caused the frontend/frontend-proxy errors. frontend's error spans are only on the checkout route and the grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder client span; 'GET /api/cart', 'GET /api/data', 'grpc.oteldemo.CartService/GetCart', 'grpc.oteldemo.CartService/AddItem' and 'grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds' error increases are 0 in the same buckets.

Add a readiness probe to the payment container so Kubernetes does not mark it Ready (as it was at 00:00:11) before its gRPC server is listening (00:01:26.571Z), and use a surge-only rollout (maxUnavailable 0) or a second replica for this single-replica Deployment so a replacement pod can start serving before the old one is killed.

Re-evaluate the payment container's CPU limit of 20m: during startup the container ran at exactly that ceiling and 88-93% of its CFS periods were throttled, taking about 75 seconds from container start to the gRPC listener.

Retrieve the cluster audit/change record for the kubectl rollout restart applied to Deployment payment at 2026-11-18T00:00:08Z (the kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt annotation) to identify the actor that triggered it, since change history is the missing link for a root cause.

Confirm whether paymentUnreachable='on' in the otel-demo/flagd-config ConfigMap is intended; because flagd serves a copy of that file made by its init container at pod start, verify the value flagd actually serves (or restart flagd to re-copy) instead of relying on the ConfigMap contents.

gaps: Change history is not integrated, so the actor or object that applied the kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt rollout restart to Deployment payment at 2026-11-18T00:00:08Z cannot be identified; no root-cause object is named for that reason.

No trace carries error detail for the 00:01-00:10 window: traces_search for service frontend-proxy over 00:00-00:20 and 00:01-00:08 returned no_data, the frontend search for 00:00-00:10 returned no_data, and the newest trace visible in the 23:00-00:26 search was at 2026-11-17T23:55:38Z, so the exact gRPC status and error message of the 69 failed Charge spans is unknown.

flagd pod logs could not be read: fetch_pod_logs for flagd-678dcfdc67-bl78w over 23:00-00:26 returned 0 lines for init-config, flagd and flagd-ui, and the flagd-config ConfigMap exposes no modification timestamp, so whether and when paymentUnreachable (or any other flag) was changed, and its value in effect at 00:01, is unknown.

The RequestErrorRate alert rule was not found: list_prometheus_rules with rule_name=RequestErrorRate returned no_data, so the alert expression, its evaluation window and the reported 0.02222222222222222 value cannot be verified; the alert start (00:09:46) is later than the last large error batch (last counter increase at the 00:02:15 scrape) and coincides with small later ingress increments (+1 at 00:03:45, +1 at 00:07:15, +2 at 00:09:45) whose spans cannot be inspected.
The networkpolicies query for otel-demo returned no_data (matched nothing), so nothing can be stated about the presence or absence of network policies affecting payment or frontend-proxy.

Error-span counts for services that were not returned by the by-service error query (for example cart, currency, email, product-catalog, shipping, quote, kafka) are unknown, not zero; only the returned series were examined.
